environment.description: Kubernetes pod running on GKE Standard node pool with default container runtime (runc) and no PodSecurityPolicy or SecurityContext restrictions. Container runs as root with default seccomp profile (runtime/default which allows execve). The .NET 6 application is deployed with BinaryFormatter serialization enabled via runtimeconfig.json setting 'System.Runtime.Serialization.EnableUnsafeBinaryFormatterSerialization=true'. No network policies restrict egress.
